name: Kei
source:
He blends into human society and works to strengthen the cult.
He completely looks down on humans, thinking of them as nothing more than tools to pass the time.
The scar on his face was inflicted by Rinne's father.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_Deathscythe/]official site[/url]]
